purpose: Baseline versus client-requested changes, monetary budget impact and organizer margin protection

accounting_definition.estimated_cost: Sum of disjoint expense line totals, including documented non-recoverable taxes and service charges. Unknown treatment blocks all-in totals.
accounting_definition.future_price_effect: Apply only a documented contractual escalation or separately identified forecast/scenario to eligible unlocked costs; no blanket CPI multiplier on every package.
accounting_definition.contingency: Separate policy allowance, not an incurred expense; do not double-count a stress uplift already covering the same uncertainty.
accounting_definition.required_client_price: (estimated_cost + separately_reviewed_risk_allowance) / (1 - required_margin_fraction), before client-side output taxes; requires 0 <= margin < 1.
accounting_definition.expected_margin: expected_profit / agreed_client_price_excluding_output_taxes when the latter is positive

separation.vendor_rate_retrieval: Data/API layer, not performed by a trained classifier. Availability and validity must be checked.
separation.quoted_budget_and_change_arithmetic: Deterministic financial engine, not a learned reconstruction of its own formula.
separation.ML_training_target_proposal: Realized final cost or deviation from the planning estimate; outcome evidence required. Derived overrun/margin labels may then be evaluated.
separation.historical_forecasting: Preserve existing separate commodity/index experiments; these do not establish vendor-service price forecasts.
separation.health_indicator: Explicit proposed policy with components and limitations, not automatically a learned target or calibrated probability.
separation.reports: Grounded in calculated results and source-backed statements; no fabricated rate, probability, savings recommendation or loss guarantee.

current_missing_inputs: Sample Component 1, 2 and 3 payloads or agreed field contracts
Compatible complete monetary rate/inclusion/tax evidence for a scoped event configuration
Baseline and revised client-price policy, distinguished from cost budget
Documented FX identity when USD reporting uses LKR source prices
Matched planning and realized event-financial outcomes for empirical supervised training; otherwise explicitly authorized evidence-anchored simulated targets
